title: The graph map does not decrease measure and has locally finite image measure
statement: Let n, k ∈ ℕ, ι : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+k} and ι' : ℝ^k → ℝ^{n+k} linear isometries with ⟨ιv, ι'w⟩ = 0, s > 0, z ∈ ℝ^{n+k}, u : ℝⁿ → ℝ^k of class C¹ on D = B_s(0), and Φ(v) := z + ιv + ι'u(v). Then (i) for every Borel A ⊆ D and every Borel g : ℝ^{n+k} → [0, ∞], ∫⁻_A g(Φ(v)) dv ≤ ∫⁻_{Φ(A)} g dHⁿ (Hⁿ = μHE[n]); and (ii) for every t < s, Hⁿ(Φ(B̄_t(0))) < ∞.
lean_statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (u : Euclid n → Euclid k) (z : Euclid (n + k)) (s : ℝ), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → 0 < s → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u (ball 0 s) → (∀ (A : Set (Euclid n)) (g : Euclid (n + k) → ℝ≥0∞), MeasurableSet A → A ⊆ ball 0 s → Measurable g → ∫⁻ v in A, g (z + ι v + ι' (u v)) ≤ ∫⁻ x in (fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) '' A, g x ∂μHE[n]) ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, t < s → μHE[n] ((fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) '' closedBall (0 : Euclid n) t) ≠ ∞
